combo3.title: Neo Kaiser Sea Horse Combo
combo3.description: Utilize Neo Kaiser Sea Horse to tribute summon Blue-Eyes monsters more efficiently. This combo demonstrates alternative summoning methods when your standard plays are unavailable.

steps.text: Normal Summon Neo Kaiser Sea Horse
Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue
Neo Kaiser Sea Horse effect sends Maiden of White from your Deck to the GY
Spirit with Eyes of Blue effect adds Mausoleum of White from your Deck to your hand
Activate Mausoleum of White and use its effect to send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck to the GY
Send BEWD to GY (Mausoleum Cost)
Use the effect of Spirit with Eyes of Blue to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your GY
Tribute Spirit (Cost)
The GY effect of Maiden of White is triggered and you Special Summon it to your field
Use the first effect of Maiden of White to send it from your side of the field to the GY to activate True Light directly from your Deck
Activate True Light from Deck
Use the effect of True Light to set Wishes for Eyes of Blue
Activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue to discard a card and search for Sage with Eyes of Blue and Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons
Send wishes to Graveyard
Discard 1 Card (Cost)
Add Sage & Roar to Hand
Add Roar to Hand
Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue and use its effect to add Effect Veiler from your Deck to your hand
Add Effect Veiler to Hand
Activate Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon from your Deck
SS Jet Dragon
Send Roar to GY
Equip Neo Ultimate to BEWD (Wishes GY Effect)
Banish Wishes for Eyes of Blue from GY
Special Summon Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon
Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon

combo4.title: Deep-Abyss Terminal Magia
